name: March in Place
say: Let's start by marching in place. Gently lift your knees.
chair_option: Hold the back of your chair

name: Shoulder Rolls
say: Now, roll your shoulders back, slowly and smoothly.

name: Arm Circles
instruction: Make small circles with your arms
say: Open your arms and make small, easy circles.

name: Side Steps
instruction: Step side to side, nice and easy
say: Let's step side to side, nice and easy.

name: Heel Raises
instruction: Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly
say: Hold your chair if you need it. Rise onto your toes, then lower slowly.
chair_option: Hold the back of your chair

name: Sit to Stand
instruction: Stand up slowly, then sit back down
say: Sit near the front of your chair. Stand up slowly, then sit back down with control.

name: Single-Leg Balance
instruction: Lift one foot just off the floor
cue: Hold your chair the whole time
say: Hold your chair, and lift one foot just off the floor. Switch sides halfway.
chair_option: Keep both hands on the chair

name: Wall Push-Ups
instruction: Bend your elbows, then push away
say: Facing a wall, place your hands on it. Bend your elbows, then push away.

name: Side Leg Raises
instruction: Lift your leg out to the side
say: Hold your chair, and lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.
chair_option: Keep a hand on the chair

name: Heel-to-Toe Walk
instruction: Place one heel in front of your toes
say: Walk heel to toe, like on a tightrope. Take your time.

name: Seated Knee Lifts
instruction: Lift one knee, then the other
say: Sitting tall, lift one knee, then the other.

name: Toe Taps
instruction: Tap your toes forward, one at a time
say: Tap your toes forward, one foot at a time.

name: Deep Breathing
say: Let's slow down. Breathe in through your nose, and out through your mouth.

name: Calf Stretch
instruction: Step back and press your heel down
say: Step one foot back and gently press your heel down. Hold the stretch.

name: Neck Stretch
instruction: Tilt your head gently to the side
say: Gently tilt your head to one side, then the other.
